visual.criterion: Original user photo remains dominant, opaque and readable; Frozen layer stack and state keyframes match V1.2 authority.
visual.method: Compare each Processing state to the registered keyframe set and inspect layer ordering.
visual.pass_condition: Photo is unmodified/dominant; overlay layers, focus and copy do not exceed the named state authority.

visual.criterion: CAPTURED/DETECTING map to one visible IMAGE_RECOGNIZING state; OUTLINE and CLASSIFYING map to the next two visible states.
visual.method: Drive each internal phase and inspect visible state identity.
visual.pass_condition: Exactly three user-visible Processing states; first two keyframes do not become two product pages.

visual.criterion: Visible Processing copy and 14sp status subtitle have one authority and a registered token/override.
visual.method: Compare visible copy and typography against Timeline, Visual Spec and effective Typography Registry.
visual.pass_condition: No unapproved copy transition; every dynamic text role resolves to a token or approved page override.

interaction.criterion: State transitions follow real pipeline events and respect minimum visual beats without fake progress.
interaction.method: Inspect deterministic event/state trace and visual timing.
interaction.pass_condition: 900ms/600ms/1250ms minimum beats and 200ms Resolve; no artificial ETA or auto-advance.

interaction.criterion: Back exits to the prior surface and never saves a catch.
interaction.method: Activate Back in each active semantic state.
interaction.pass_condition: Cancellation is a user exit, not an error or persistence path.

interaction.criterion: State transitions preserve the continuous Edge Field clock and current geometry identity.
interaction.method: Compare segment phase/geometry before and after state transitions.
interaction.pass_condition: No field reset, phase jump or new fake progress beat.

accessibility.criterion: Reduced Motion and degradation change visual activity only and retain the same semantic state order.
accessibility.method: Review FULL/BALANCED/LITE, Reduce Motion and D0-D4 output against semantic invariants.
accessibility.pass_condition: Three product states and status meaning remain available; no focus/contour appears without real detection.

accessibility.criterion: Back is reachable with a registered 44×44dp target and state semantics.
accessibility.method: Measure Back hit target and inspect accessible name/state.
accessibility.pass_condition: Target meets touch.minimum and exits without saving.

error.criterion: No Fish, Image Quality and Technical Failure remain distinct; each exits Processing without creating a record.
error.method: Inject each real issue event and trace the next page/state.
error.pass_condition: Issue category and recovery path match the canonical flow; no relabeling between classes.

error.criterion: Network/pipeline failure does not display No Fish/Image Quality copy or a fabricated retry duration.
error.method: Drive a reported technical failure and inspect the exit state.
error.pass_condition: TECHNICAL_FAILURE route is used and remains separate from the 3+2 recovery states.
